description: Poll Vercel for deployment state, emit AssetMaterialization/Observation on READY, and fire a Dagster job. Optionally fire on ERROR for alert flows.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: Vercel project ID (prj_...). Set this OR project_name.

team_id.label: Team ID
team_id.description: Vercel team ID (team_...). Required for team-scoped projects.

api_token_env_var.description: Env var holding a Vercel API token (create at https://vercel.com/account/tokens).
api_token_env_var.label: API Token Env Var

api_base_url.description: Vercel API base URL (override for self-hosted proxies).
api_base_url.label: API Base URL

job_name.description: Dagster job to trigger on terminal success.
job_name.label: Job Name

asset_key.description: Optional Dagster asset key. When set, emits an AssetMaterialization / AssetObservation. '/'-separated.
asset_key.label: Asset Key

asset_event_type.description: 'materialization' (default) or 'observation'. Use 'observation' when paired with vercel_deploy_trigger.
asset_event_type.label: Asset Event Type

error_state_triggers_job.description: When true, ERROR deployments ALSO fire the job (with a tag) — useful for alert / rollback flows.
error_state_triggers_job.label: Error State Triggers Job
